inductions.syntax: induction inputs generalizing before after result with
inductions.IH: ∀ (before after : EnumerationState.State Symbol Constraint) (result : Option (List (Fragments.Fragment Symbol))), StorageValid before → (∀ input ∈ rest, ∀ sc ∈ input.2, sc.var < before.counter) → Success (SourcePruningEnumerationEdgeTraversal.runStaged (rest.map (fun input => (input.1, input.2, SourcePruningEnumerationShallowChild.prepareChild (EnumGuard := Constraint) input.2 input.1)))) before result after → StorageValid after ∧ (match result with | none => True | some fragments => FragmentsBound after.counter fragments) ∧ before.counter ≤ after.counter
